Questions, answered

Frequently asked questions

All FAQsContact us
Do I need a national certification?

For most roles, yes: for example the RRT credential for respiratory therapy or ASCP certification for laboratory science. Some states also require a state license. Your recruiter confirms exactly what each role needs.

Do you place new graduate therapists?

Yes, on assignments where the facility offers supervision or mentorship. Tell your recruiter you are a new graduate or clinical fellow and we will show you the roles that fit.

Do I need a state license as well as my registry?

It depends on the state. Some require a separate state license for certain modalities and some do not. We tell you what the state needs and how long it usually takes.

Are there local contracts, or only travel?

Both. Many allied roles are available as local contracts or per diem as well as travel assignments, and some facilities hire permanently.
